headline: A video of Tesla's Optimus robot answering with Grok's voice showed a slow, hesitant machine rather than a ready product.
score_reason: Content appears to be a September 2025 article resurfacing; a single demo video with no new announcement.
importance_line: Anyone expecting Optimus to do household chores soon can see the gap between Musk's sales targets and a robot that needs several nudges to walk toward a Coke, with the added doubt that this coverage looks about a year old.
summary: Mashable reports on a video posted by Salesforce chief Marc Benioff of a next-generation Tesla Optimus humanoid fitted with xAI's Grok voice assistant, in which the robot answers slowly and needs repeated prompts before taking a few steps toward a kitchen to fetch a drink. The outlet's verdict is that the demo is a small step past earlier human-assisted showings and far from Elon Musk's aim of selling millions of the robots a year; the article's references suggest the clip dates from Sep 2025, so this is older material resurfacing.
notes: Probable re-date: article internals match Sep 2025 (Master Plan Part 4, Salesforce cuts). Score lowered from 5 to 3. Candidate for the QA hold-back list under Full Report rule 4.1.
